patch.geometry: axis-aligned finite rectangle in continuous world metres
patch.normal: unit axis sign pointing from owning solid shape into the acoustically accessible air half-space
patch.source_and_listener_rule: both endpoints must be strictly on the normal-facing air half-space

image_source.rule: mirror source across the continuous patch plane, intersect image-to-listener segment with the plane, and admit only an intersection inside the finite rectangle

visibility.rule: trace source and listener independently to the air-side offset reflection point using the canonical Amanatides-Woo crossing and tie rules
visibility.reason: the offset endpoint must lie in air; if the owning shape still occupies it, the patch/normal extraction is invalid

claim_boundary: D121 local-plane contract for offline Minecraft shape fixtures. It defines continuous first-order geometry and CPU visibility semantics but does not yet enable live early taps or claim arbitrary VoxelShape union extraction is implemented.
